description: Source code implementing shell commands for ARM SiP service management, including registration, unregistration, opening, closing, sending messages, and retrieving service info.

methods.name: parse_common_args
methods.description: Parses common command-line arguments to retrieve and validate the SIP service controller.

methods.name: cmd_reg
methods.description: Handles registration of a SIP service method.

methods.name: cmd_unreg
methods.description: Handles unregistration of a SIP service token.

methods.name: cmd_open
methods.description: Opens a SIP service connection with optional timeout.

methods.name: cmd_send_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon sending a message, prints response details.

methods.name: cmd_send
methods.description: Sends a message via SIP service with multiple optional parameters.

methods.name: cmd_info
methods.description: Displays information about SIP service controller and clients.
